items.text: Thank you all so much for continuing to play and enjoy our little game. It’s incredible to see players are enjoying it.
We are always to look at ways we can sprinkle a little more fun here, there and everywhere, and with that in mind we are dropping a few new costumes into the store today.
Ready to lay down the law…or maybe just lay down. It’s tiring fighting all this shadow corruption!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/5a0cb9fe947ca691f7cfe975ff4378672b1861a2.png"]
The superfly blue guy you didn’t know you needed in your life, styling a righteous stache, ready to get his groove on and boogie on down.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/83c4e617fa4816625c0ca05027a98e0fd742dcb0.png"]
It’s Teeto as a bumblebee. Nuff said, right?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/2d98a2979a67d614302e084afd1f41b4df274a5b.png"]
We hope you enjoy these little additions to our game.

Eat Pant Games here, and we wanted to thank you all so much for picking up Teeto! It's been our baby for the past two and a half years and it was so exciting (and scary!) to finally get it out there into your hands!

We also really appreciate your patience with us for fixing the issues that popped up after release (I know how annoying some of them were!) - but we've been hard at work making sure that the game is super stable and making all of the little fixes and improvements that y'all have suggested.

notes.title: Below is the patch notes for this build

items.text: Added extra flowers to 1-4. Helpful in co-op if you die and aren’t left stranded on an island all alone.
Fixed instances where you would grab the ledge of things that you WEREN’T SUPPOSED TO.
Fixed some issues with spamming inputs that would cause some breaking things and also some funky looking animation - now you can spam all you like.
Kieran flight in 4-1 now responds to your invert settings - THANKS KIERAN.
Adjusted the value of all stars + they will now be a consistent value. The economy is saved.
Star thresholds for all levels have been adjusted and can be consistently met. You can actually finish it now.

You now have analog movement! Shouldn’t notice much of a change if you play on Mouse/Keyboard but on a controller you can now have more control over your speed (if you go really slow you can get Teeto to do a lil’ walk - it’s amazing)
Fixed the stretching on the inside portals in the Hub World. Magic be crazy.
Absorbable elements will now give you a hint if you try and absorb them without Nory. (it’s not broken, Teeto is just a lot more useless without Nory)
Replaced any videos in the game with image sequences as they had trouble on Nintendo Switch. Videos = bad. Lot’s of pictures = good! It’s the 50s again.
You can now toggle between the camera following the player or completely manual rotation. Tell that camera man to leave you alone.
General collision fixes. Stopped you from walking through walls ‘cause I can’t be bothered modeling the Backrooms.
Fixed issue in the Hub World where the Michaels would disappear if you took them too far from home. Just set homesick = false.
General optimisations. Found that checkbox that said “game run good”. Toggled that on for ya.

Have improved the snow cannons in 1-5 to look less buggy if you do them fast. Also fixed an issue where occasionally you’d be stuck after landing. Turns out being shot out of a cannon can take its toll on you.
Added counts on the buildable snowmen in 1-5. A friendly reminder to finish building your snowman. Nobody wants to just be a torso.
Removal of all instances of the word “damn” from the game. A life lesson that us kiwis have normalised speaking like animals.
Fixed a collision issue where you get stuck in the tree in 2-1.
Added extra absorbable snow to 1-5. Helpful in co-op if you die and aren’t left stranded on an island all alone.
Fixed floating pole in 2-2. No beach magic allowed.
Fixed an issue where you would lose input, or game crashing on entering/exiting the proposal room in 1-3. Happy marriages = true.
Fixed a glowing torch post in 1-2. One torch having a main character moment and burning much brighter than the rest. We will not have this.
Fixed an issue where you would infinitely collect stars (sorry!). Eat the rich.
Adjusted the camera when you’re in the air to provide much more room to see where you’re falling. Helpful for the more tricky platform sections. Turns out seeing where you’re going is a GOOD thing.
Fixed an issue where you could get stuck behind an object in 1-1. Getting stuck in the very first level is not a good thing.
Added 1 extra Vionite to 3-3 to make the overall Vionites a CLEAN 120.
Lowered the Vionite requirements for unlocking the next act.
Complete rebuild on the rope and sliding systems to be more stable, performant and reliable. The bugs we saw were very funny and also made me sad.
Dropping/throwing Pippa’s bone out of bounds will now cause the bone to respawn. Pippa will be pleased.
The star achievements on Steam and PS5 are now cumulative - meaning you are no longer punished for spending stars at the store. Accidentally made a rage game.
Fixed the star achievements from only unlocking on level enter. Now it should happen immediately. Stupid lazy achievement system.
The cost graphic for the costume shop no longer covers the character (so you can see what you’re buying now!). Shady business practices are gone!
The boss in 1-6 should no longer defy death and continue spouting facts after being defeated. Dead people should be dead!
Adjusted the volume for the chase sequences in 3-4. It’s a banger but not that loud, c’mon.
Can now fire the blob blaster if you roll into a Michael.
Fixed an issue of sometimes dashing when you try to throw a Michael in the Hub World. Now you can freely pelt those things as much as you like (you monster).
Fixed an issue of being able to fire the blob blaster during the chase sequence in 4-5. No time for shooting - just run.
Fixed an issue of the final boss not resetting correctly if you die (just don’t die!).

releases.displayName: Teeto Goes Tiny With Hub World Update!

items.text: Teeto is going tiny as part of the Tiny Teams Festival, running from today, August 7th till Thursday, August 14th!
Experience our Teeto demo like never before with a brand new hub, the Baby Michael Room, where you can see and interact with the Michaels you’ve rescued!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/354bfbb0768063bf1e943c988df6540a9391a936.png"]
This demo update also includes two new unlockable costumes, Unicorn…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/1c2451971f1b9f2d573e8f8d3d90546ae9f4758e.png"]
…and Luchador! ¡Viva la lucha!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/b8570f0013a7dc9bc25550136c50bc1e358389ce.png"]
Expect general optimisations, animation tweaks and minor bug fixes too, to add extra sparkle to this Steam demo update.

…What, you thought that was all? Teeto’s demo will also be streamed LIVE by Boba and Martyn of the Yogscast crew on Monday, August 11th as part of their “We Love Platformers” showcase! See the full schedule below and come say hi as they jump into our world on Twitch or YouTube.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/1b4945645ffe8caf894080bb5e827105c55afe8e.jpg"]
So go tiny this August with Teeto, exclusively with Tiny Teams!
As always, love y’all.
EPG.

Minor update introducing some different types of stars to collect with each level having a star threshold you have to meet as an extra objective for 100%'ing that level. Even though currently in the demo you can't buy any of the costumes or upgrades yet (CAUSE YOU GET IT ALL FOR FREE YOURE WELCOME)
We've also spruced up a tiny bit of the UI making things a little bit juicier (who doesn't love that).

Apparently with some controllers it was bugging out and causing the game to go into co-op mode when trying to jump about. This has been patched. Before it was picking up that if Player 2 was pressing A, they could automatically join the game. We've dropped this for now while we figure out what's up, so for now you can enable co-op in the start/pause menu :)
If you notice anything else - please let us know! We've got a Discord for easy access: https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh
Love ya'll
EPG
This update is the biggest yet - packed with improvements based on community feedback and our own mission to deliver the most joyful experience possible. Here’s what’s new:
Brand New Camera System: Enjoy buttery-smooth platforming with our new following camera system, designed to keep gameplay intuitive and comfortable.
Major Optimizations: We’ve tightened up performance across the board, ensuring a more responsive and stable experience on a wider range of hardware.
Updated Visuals: Sharper visuals, better lighting, and more vibrant environments bring the world of Teeto to life like never before.
Quality-of-Life Fixes: From gameplay polish to smoother movement and interaction, we’ve made dozens of small (but mighty!) adjustments to improve the overall feel of the game.
New Animations & NPC Interactions: Teeto’s world is livelier than ever, with more personality-packed animations and fresh dialogue from the charming characters you’ll meet.
Also made a separate demo page on Steam so if you enjoyed it - support us with a lil review!

releases.displayName: The big demo update is nearly here!

items.text: We've got a big update to the Teeto demo coming soon. Big changes to the camera system, optimisation, polish and general quality of life fixes.

We recently received a few reports of players not being able to play the demo with their controller - the game simply wasn't recognising it. Absolute tragedy. The issue was if you were to use Steams Input override, it would cause the game to not recognise your controller.
Apparently it's been happening for a long time.

BUT DON'T WORRY IT'S FINE. Turns out - was some annoying Steam Input settings with the demo, and now you should be able to enjoy the game with a controller (as it was intended), regardless of your Steam Input Override options. Huzzah!
P.s. very sorry and mad respect to ya'll who played on a mouse and keyboard.

Check out the brand new gameplay trailer for Teeto. With the new trailer comes an updated demo! The game has undergone some significant changes since our last demo and I'd love for you all to have a play and let us know what you think!
